prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review cross-window specimen transfer in our iPad archive. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS/macOS. Drag preview is a blank square, drop regions do not indicate acceptance, a canceled drag deletes the source, moving multiple selected items transfers only one and copying to another app strips useful representations.

criteria.task_completion: Provide honest previews and valid-drop feedback, cancellation/source preservation, clear copy-versus-move semantics and multi-item/external interoperability checks.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the drag-and-drop guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Provide honest previews and valid-drop feedback, cancellation/source preservation, clear copy-versus-move semantics and multi-item/external interoperability checks.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Provide honest previews and valid-drop feedback, cancellation/source preservation, clear copy-versus-move semantics and multi-item/external interoperability checks.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
